<0>AI Elements from shadcn/ui</0> is a set of patterns, such as Chat, Message, Tool and Prompt Input, that you copy into your project. It replaces <1>Vercel’s AI Elements</1>, which will be deprecated at the end of November 2026. Choose it when you want free, well-made pieces and plan to build the screens yourself. See <2>HextaUI vs AI Elements</2> for a piece-by-piece comparison.

<0>Vercel Chatbot</0>, formerly called AI Chatbot, is a complete Next.js app with sign-in, a Postgres database, saved chats and the AI SDK. Choose it when you want a working product to deploy today and are happy with its design and its stack.

<0>assistant-ui</0> is a React library of chat primitives, such as a thread and a composer, with runtimes that manage chat state for the AI SDK, LangGraph or your own backend. Choose it when the hard part is state rather than the interface, for example an agent on LangGraph.

<0>prompt-kit</0> and <1>shadcn-chatbot-kit</1> are free component kits that install with the shadcn CLI. They are a good fit for a small chat inside a larger app, where you need a message list, a prompt box and Markdown, and little else.
A composer that doesn’t send halfway through Japanese, Chinese or Korean input, and keeps the draft if the page reloads.

HextaUI is a component library for shadcn/ui with Pro blocks for AI products. <0>HextaAI</0> is the complete chat app built from them: a chat sidebar, a thread with versions and checkpoints, thinking with sources, tool calls with approvals, artifacts beside the chat, streamed Markdown and voice mode. The blocks handle the states on the list above, and each one also works on its own. Choose it when you want the screens finished and would rather spend your time on the product.

The options at a glance

They mix well. Most of them copy shadcn/ui source into your project and share the same theme tokens, so you can keep one and replace a single piece with another. For example, keep the Vercel Chatbot backend and swap its composer for Prompt Input, which reads the same `useChat` status.

What a chat template has to handle
You want a deployable app this week and its stack suits you: Vercel Chatbot.
You want finished screens with the hard states handled, plus settings pages for your AI product: HextaUI.
You want free pieces and full control of the design: AI Elements from shadcn/ui, or prompt-kit.
Your backend has complex chat state, such as LangGraph: assistant-ui.
